article.headline: Djobet’s 19 help Texas State down McNeese 95-69
article.description: — Paul Djobet scored 19 points as Texas State beat McNeese 95-69 on Sunday.
article.linkText: Djobet’s 19 help Texas State down McNeese 95-69
article.story: SAN MARCOS, Texas -- — Paul Djobet scored 19 points as Texas State beat McNeese 95-69 on Sunday. Djobet also added 10 rebounds for the Bobcats (7-0). Kaden Gumbs added 14 points while shooting 3 for 6 (2 for 3 from 3-point range) and 6 of 6 from the free-throw line while they also had five rebounds. Caleb Steger shot 4 for 6 (2 for 4 from 3-point range) and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 13 points. It was the seventh straight win for the Bobcats. Larry Johnson finished with 29 points and three steals for the Cowboys (2-2). McNeese also got 20 points from Elijah Moore. Alier Maluk also had five points. Texas State took the lead with 17:52 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Djobet led their team in scoring with 10 points in the first half to help put them up 50-27 at the break. Texas State pulled away with an 8-0 run in the second half to extend a 21-point lead to 29 points. They outscored McNeese by three points in the final half, as Gumbs led the way with a team-high 12 second-half points. Up next Up next for Texas State is a Wednesday matchup with Alcorn State, and McNeese visits Louisiana on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
